items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived pullback constructed earlier in the chapter is left adjoint to the derived pushforward, with the displayed bifunctorial identification of hom groups (statement lines 3989-4003). The proof chooses representatives on which the derived functors are computed naively (proof lines 4005-4006) and transports the abelian adjunction between pullback and pushforward to those representatives (proof lines 4006-4008). The non-formal content is the choice of representatives making the abelian adjunction applicable. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one adjunction transport.
